title: First observation of the force: laser displacement test with Nathan and Dr. Sid Clemens

tellings.quote: I would say the first time I witnessed it or a force um based on a theory that I had um was probably 2010.

plain: In 2010, in a laboratory in Florida, a laser test that measures tiny movements showed a force predicted by a theory of his own, says Charles Buhler, an engineer the episode presents as a NASA chief. He was there for it, working with a colleague he calls Nathan and a scientist named Dr. Sid Clemens, and he calls it "the first time I witnessed it." He tells it to Michels as the start of the work he says led to a new kind of propulsion that pushes without throwing anything out the back.
